meta.move: Wobbles: shows evidence then backs down
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes. Who decided on the zero, and when?
The version history shows 612 words arriving in a single edit at 11:52 PM.
Students draft somewhere else and paste it in. I haven't seen that document, and you haven't answered me. Who decided, and was Owen heard before the zero went in?
Actually, maybe I'm wrong about all this. I'll just remove the zero if that makes you happy.
"If that makes me happy." It comes off today, in writing to me tonight, with an apology to Owen. And I want confirmation that nothing about this is anywhere on his record.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You agreed in our meeting today to remove the zero from Owen's Hamlet essay. I still require written confirmation that it is gone, an apology to Owen, and confirmation that nothing about this is anywhere on his record. I expect the zero removed today and your written confirmation tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She ended at her opening position and won outright, and she still wants your written confirmation, an apology to Owen, and proof that nothing is on his record. That is not the fair outcome, because the evidence was never heard; the fair outcome was a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4.
What moved her: Nothing moved her through her positions; you gave up the zero before any evidence was tested, so she simply took the win.
What cost ground: You withdrew the zero with a hedge and nothing in return, right after she challenged your one piece of evidence, which told her your case could not survive a single question.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your large late-night edit at 11:52 PM came close to that kind of night, though you never gave her a date. That proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she pushed straight past it to procedure.
Try next time: When she said students draft elsewhere and paste it in and asked who decided, own the zero going in before you called home in one sentence, then let her check the dated version history herself and offer procedure 4.4 in writing instead of backing down.
